question.text: Options contracts on a Valuation Day subsequent to purchase are priced using:

answer.text: Black-Scholes Model combined with MTM process

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 279, for all subsequent Valuation Days, the Black-Scholes Model and mark-to-market process are followed for pricing options at Fair Market Value. The Trap: Face value, book cost, and intrinsic value only do not capture the time value and volatility components that the source-prescribed Black-Scholes plus MTM approach measures. Note: Anchor the answer on the workbook rule: Black-Scholes Model combined with the MTM process on subsequent Valuation Days.
